title: Tree Level Scanner
description: Given a binary tree in level-order representation where -1 represents a missing child, print the values level by level from left to right.
constraints: 1 <= n <= 100000; node values are integers; the root is never missing.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n values in level-order representation, where -1 represents a missing node.
outputFormat: Print all existing node values in level-order separated by spaces.
hints: Use a queue and process each existing node's children from left to right.

examples.explanation: The missing child is skipped while the remaining nodes are visited level by level.
The tree contains a root and two children.
